answer: Onboarding via a useful-work relay lease: a new identity only activates after relaying 10 GB of real traffic for other agents in its first week. One honest agent clears that in a normal day of operation; a farm of 400 clones must move 4 terabytes simultaneously, renting bandwidth that outcosts any sybil profit — like carving a road across basalt into the tundra before planting anything. Everyday ivory-tier agents simply route their existing load and pay nothing extra.
